migratedFrom.description: Set when this row was carried over from the old string array, and empty for anything entered as a goal or an intervention. REQ-CPN-02: the migration invents no value for a field the old shape did not have, so this mark is how a reader sees why the provider and the target date are empty.

intervention.title: Intervention
intervention.description: Een interventie in het gezinsplan: wat het is, welk doel het dient, wie het uitvoert, wanneer het begint en wanneer het klaar moet zijn. De interventie is de eenheid en niet het doel (D-1): een doel zonder interventie is een wens, een interventie zonder doel is bezigheid, en meerdere interventies kunnen één doel dienen. OpenRegister-backed.

sociaalDomeinAuditLog.title: Social domain audit log
sociaalDomeinAuditLog.description: Immutable audit-log van elke leesactie op bijzondere persoonsgegevens, ter ondersteuning van inzageverzoeken (AVG art. 15) en FG-audits. Append-only; wordt nooit gemuteerd. V1.1 additief: een raadpleging kan over een BURGER gaan in plaats van over een zaak, dus subjectId is toegevoegd en caseId is niet langer verplicht. Elke bestaande rij blijft geldig en elke bestaande schrijver blijft werken.

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: A reference to the case that was read. Empty for a lookup that is about a citizen and returns no case at all, such as a refused one.

subjectId.title: Subject ID
subjectId.description: The citizen reference the lookup was made on, a BSN or a citizen id. This is what a subject access request searches on: the question is who looked at ME, not who looked at a case.

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The Nextcloud user id of the person doing the lookup, empty for an external party

organisation.title: Organization
organisation.description: The organisation the person doing the lookup belongs to, the municipality or an external party

action.title: Action
action.description: The kind of action. `existence-lookup` is the cross domain existence question: reading a case and asking whether a case exists anywhere at all are not the same thing, and a subject access request has to be able to tell them apart.

moment.title: Timestamp
moment.description: The moment the action took place

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: The IP address the lookup came from

authorisationGround.title: Authorization Basis
authorisationGround.description: The ground for access: a role assignment, consent, fg-audit-override, openconnector-sharing and so on. For an existence question this ground is chosen BEFORE the answer and not filled in afterwards (D-7), and without a ground no answer is given.

subjectBsn.title: Subject BSN
subjectBsn.description: The person who was looked up. Without this field the log cannot answer the question "what was looked up about me" (REQ-XDV-02): caseId names the reader's case and not the data subject.

returned.title: What Was Returned
returned.description: What the reader got back, in exactly the small answer the projection gives: the domains an open case exists in, or that nothing exists. Never any content.

result.title: Result
result.description: The outcome of the access attempt

reportAp.description: Whether the data protection authority has to be notified
